what: A platform-only CI failure hid which OS actually failed. A rollup of CI results across multiple OS/job matrix entries showed a failure without saying which platform was red, so the cause had to be rediscovered by hand instead of being named in the run report.
rule: Name the platform when a CI failure is red on only some OS/job matrix entries, not all.
fix: Enforcement: `ship` prints `platform-only failure: <os>` with the failing test ids when a CI failure lands on only a subset of the OS/job matrix. Regression coverage is in `tests/lessons120-ship.test.mjs`.
